subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay media from requireMention group messages that did not address the bot, and under what bounded retention and visibility policy?
rationale: The user impact and source path are clear, but storing unmentioned room media for a later agent turn can expose sensitive group content unless maintainers explicitly approve the boundary.

options.title: Approve bounded retention
options.body: Allow a fix that records only authorized local image history media under existing group/context visibility limits, bounded count and TTL, with regression and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Keep text-only no-download behavior
options.body: Treat unmentioned group media as intentionally private and document that mention-gated group history may contain media placeholders without attachments.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Add a narrow opt-in only if maintainers decide existing group history and context visibility policy is not enough for this privacy boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded retention
recommendation.body: Allow a fix that records only authorized local image history media under existing group/context visibility limits, bounded count and TTL, with regression and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged current behavior that skips unmentioned Telegram media before download, so they are the best current routing candidate for this boundary decision.
